Container.Name: Airbridge
Container.Overview:
Airbridge - Anything → Everywhere
Bridge DLNA/UPnP audio streams to AirPlay speakers and Chromecast devices. Create virtual DLNA renderers that forward audio to your smart speakers.
Perfect for streaming from Music Assistant, Plex, Roon, or any DLNA-compatible media server to: • AirPlay devices (HomePods, Sonos, Apple TV, Juke Audio) • Chromecast devices (Google Nest Hub, Chromecast Audio)
Features: • Web admin UI with real-time playback status via WebSocket • Automatic discovery of AirPlay (_raop._tcp) and Chromecast (_googlecast._tcp) devices • Create and manage multiple DLNA-to-AirPlay/Chromecast bridges • Volume control support • Persistent SQLite database for configuration
⚠️ PORT CONFIGURATION: The web admin runs on port 8200 by default. To use a different port, you MUST set the AIRBRIDGE_PORT variable below. The WebUI link will update automatically.
Requires host network mode for mDNS device discovery and SSDP announcements.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for database and configuration

Config.Description: Port for the web admin interface. Change if 8200 conflicts with another service.
